_help: ONE FILE FOR ALL GLOBAL SETTINGS. Edit here, or override per run: CLI (node build.mjs --type terminal --theme dracula --voice-speed 1.1), env (REEL_TYPE=terminal VOICE_NAME=am_adam) or the generic  --set section.key=value  (repeatable, e.g. --set typing.cps=0.03 --set walkthrough.fontSize=26). Precedence: CLI > env > build.mjs > this file. Content (what the video says) stays in build.mjs; everything about how it looks/sounds is here.

reel._help: THE MAIN SWITCHES. type = which kind of reel (a preset from 'reelTypes' below). language = key of 'languages'. theme = key of 'themes'. layout = 'auto' (the reel type decides) or a key of layout.presets. CLI: --type walkthrough --lang javascript --theme dracula --layout tall

reelTypes._help: Presets chosen by reel.type. scene = default scene type for entries in steps[] that do not set their own 'type' (scene types: method code concept compare tip walkthrough flow blocks terminal). intro/outro = grid | card | off. Add your own presets here (e.g. a 'linux-tips' that uses scene 'terminal'). Every scene can still override 'type' inside build.mjs, so one reel can mix scene types.

methods.label: Methods / API cheat sheet (code + before/after + terminal)

compare.label: Comparison: A vs B (code panels or feature table)

tips.label: Tips & tricks: instead of this -> do this

walkthrough.label: Long code: files, functions, scroll bar, highlighted ranges

terminal.label: Linux / shell commands with real terminal output

mixed.label: Anything goes: set 'type' on every step

languages._help: Per language: label (shown in thumbnails), ext (file extension), syntax (highlighter grammar: python javascript bash java c go rust sql json generic), color (tab icon: one colour or two for a diagonal split), status (status-bar text), run (command used to execute snippets so the output is REAL; {file}=script path, {dir}=scratch folder; null = you must supply 'out' yourself), prompt (shown before the output; {file}), keywords (extra words to highlight). Add any language by copying a block.

themes._help: Colours. 'syntax' maps token classes: k keyword, s string, n number, f function/call, v name, o operator, c comment, t type/class, fl flag (shell), d decorator. cell*/hit/del/new colours are used by the before/after rows and the diagram nodes.

layout._help: Frame geometry in px (frame is 1080x1920; keep key content between y 285 and ~1500 so platform UI never covers it). preset 'classic' = original look: code stage, fixed TERMINAL panel, caption, faded code texture. 'tall' = taller stage (no fixed terminal panel; scenes draw their own), caption under the stage. Make your own preset by copying one. headerCompact is used by scenes that need more height.

captions._help: Burned-in captions (the SRT file is always written). mode: 'speech' = the captions show EVERYTHING the voice says, chunked into short phrases and timed to the voice; 'cap' = only the short cap:[..] lines you write in build.mjs. maxChars = longest phrase on screen. fontSize/lineHeight px. enabled=false hides them in the video.

typing._help: Typing animation: cps = seconds per character, minLine = shortest time for one line, gap = pause between lines.

timing._help: Minimum scene lengths in seconds (the voiceover can lengthen them). beat = one narrated sub-step inside a long scene.

execute._help: Snippets are RUN so on-screen output is real. enabled=false: you must give 'out' on every scene. timeoutSec per run. Scenes can opt out with run:false or give their own out:[...]. Shell scenes only run commands that you mark run:true.

walkthrough._help: Long-code scenes: fontSize px, lineHeight ratio, scrollSeconds = scroll animation time, scrollbar = show the scroll bars, dim = how dark the lines outside the highlighted range get (0-1), maxOutLines = terminal lines shown. panelMargin = px between the screen edge and the code panel.

diagram._help: Flowchart / block scenes: fontSize px, nodeGapX / nodeGapY px between nodes, strokeWidth, trace = animate a glowing token along 'trace' paths, edgeSeconds = time to draw one arrow. maxScale = how much a small diagram may be enlarged to use the space (1 = never).

terminal._help: Linux terminal scenes: user/host/cwd form the prompt; fontSize px; windowTitle shown in the title bar ('' = user@host: cwd); lineHeight ratio; anatomy = show the chip row that explains each part of a command.

logo._help: Channel logo shown for the whole video. anchor: top-left|top-center|top-right|center-left|center|center-right|bottom-left|bottom-center|bottom-right. x,y = px moved inward from that corner. width = logo width in px (height follows). Frame is 1080x1920.  CLI: --logo off | --logo-width 240

watermark._help: Text watermark across the screen. fontSize px, opacity 0-1, rotate deg (negative = rising to the right). anchor/x/y as for logo. tile:true repeats it over the whole frame (tileGapX/tileGapY px). CLI: --watermark off | --watermark-opacity 0.1

thumbnail._style_options: editor blueprint poster terminal cells q_quiz q_exam q_count q_bug q_versus sticky neon swiss levels chalk  |  all (renders every style + a contact sheet)

endCard._help: The chosen thumbnail is shown full-screen as the last frame(s) of the video. CLI: --end-card off | --end-card-seconds 1.5. With style 'all' the first rendered style is used.

voice._provider_options: kokoro = real Kokoro-82M TTS (needs setup.sh) | mock = placeholder tones with realistic timing, for layout tests | none = no voiceover
voice._voice_examples: af_heart af_bella af_nova af_sky am_adam am_michael bf_emma bm_george  (54 voices; run: node build.mjs --list-voices)

sound._help: Final volume of a sound = master x sfx.volume x category.volume (1.0 = the file's own level). Voice volume = master x voice.volume. Env: SFX=0, SFX_MASTER=0.5, SFX_TYPING=0 or 0.3 (any category), VOICE=0, VOICE_VOLUME=0.8.

ding.use: success: new item, result, call to action
